notes.title: Weekly Update 1
notes.notes:
This week's progress has mostly been back-end stuff, code optimisation and as many bug fixes as I could fit in! Alot of issues with Unity slowed it down a little but next week should make up for it with more new content!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33082373/7aad50d1408a7b91ba698c09ec4ecd4334d03273.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Cybrus is officially live!
notes.notes:
Well guys we did it, Cybrus has made it to release!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33082373/7aad50d1408a7b91ba698c09ec4ecd4334d03273.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Possible Launch Delay!
notes.notes:
Due to unforseen circumstances and a little human error the Steam store page is under review for 2-3 days, since Valve don't allow releases on weekends this means the game could possible be delayed until after the weekend!

Sincere apologies to anyone awaiting release, to try and soften the blow I will schedule a 10% launch discount for the first week!
